# Underarmor Styles: New SPECIAL points system

![Underarmor Styles: New SPECIAL Points System](/uploads/653_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update 04/21/2026] Vault style plan reduced to 200 gold

With Patch 66 on March 3rd, 2026, underarmor now works differently, as the **Bonus Special points are no longer **set** by the type of underarmor** (Casual, Secret Service, Construction Technician, etc.) and the shielded mod. Instead, these types and the food now set the resistances and the new style sets the bonus SPECIALs. This means: your underarmor no longer has any bonus SPECIALs until you have installed one of the new styles.

In principle it doesn't matter which sub-armor you use. The only difference is the base resistances. All **SPECIAL bonuses are now only set via the styles**.

## Underarmor styles

Here is an overview of all the new underarmor styles and where you can get them.

| Blueprint: Underarmor Style (Agent) | +4 PER, +2 INT, +4 AGI | Enclave Activities (5% chance) | 
| Blueprint: Underarmor Style (Construction Engineer) | +3 STR, +3 PER, +4 CHA | Atlantic City: The Human Condition (once weekly) | 
| Blueprint: Underarmor Style (Casual) | +5 CHA, +3 INT, +2 LCK | Event: Neurological Warfare (5%) Event: A Colossal Problem (5%) Event: Seismic Activity (5%) Event: Scorched Earth (5%) | 
| Blueprint: Underarmor Style (Navy) | +4 STR, +3 END, +3 AGI | Mutated Events & Atlantic City: The Game of All Games (1x weekly) | 
| Blueprint: Underarmor Style (Raider) | +2 PER, +3 AGI, +5 LCK | Event: Moonshine Jamboree (5%) | 
| Blueprint: Underarmor Style (Secret Service) | +4 END, +3 PER, +3 STR | Reginald Vault 79 (200 Gold) | 
| Blueprint: Underarmor Style (Brotherhood of Steel) | +4 STR, +3 END, +3 INT | Event: Hardness Test (Best) (5%) Event: Against the Sound Barrier (5%) | 
| Blueprint: Underarmor Style (Vault Suit) | +2 END, +5 INT, +3 LCK | Samuel Foundation (200 Gold) | 

## **Underarmor Lining: Resistances**

| **Food** | **DR** | **HE** | **FR** | **CR** | **PR** | **RR** | 
| Default | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 
| Treated | 10 | 10 | 15 | 15 | 48 | 6 | 
| Resistant | 6 | 10 | 31 | 31 | 15 | 10 | 
| Protective | 48 | 23 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 
| Shielded | 23 | 31 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 48 | 

*DR: Damage Resistance, ER: Energy Resistance, FR: Fire Resistance, CR: Cryp Resistance, PR: Poison Resistance, RR: Radiation Resistance*

Source table: Fallout 76 Datamining Discord

## Recommendation

The best underarmor before getting all the other style plans is the **underarmor style Vault Suit**. You can get this in **Foundation** from **Samuel** for **200 gold**. This gives you +2 Stamina, +5 Intelligence and +3 Luck. If you want to use other underarmor styles later, you already have a good basis.
